newsitem.title: COSTA RICA: Costa Rica names new trade minister.
newsitem.headline: Costa Rica names new trade minister.

text.p: Costa Rican President Jose Maria Figueres on Friday named Jose Manuel Salazar as the country's new trade minister, replacing Jose Rossi, who resigned on Thursday because of differences with the foreign minister.
"I am pleased and truly satisfied to announce that I have named Jose Manuel Salazar as the new trade minister," Figueres told a news confernce.
Salazar had led an association of Central American business leaders before being named to his new post.

Rossi resigned on Thursday along with his deputy minister, Francisco Chacon; the ministry's director of international negotiations, Anabel Gonzalez; and the ministry's director of investment and services, Roberto Echandi.
They quit in protest of what they called intervention by Foreign Minister Fernando Naranjo in affairs pertaining to their ministry.

Specifically, they blamed Naranjo for intervening in negotiations over a trade agreement with the Caribbean trade bloc known as CARICOM and in negotiations with Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto during a visit to Costa Rica last year.
